Theorem 1 (Chapter 131)

Subject: quantum information | ID: 2109

Statement

Let X be a symmetric space with rational structure S. Then the cohomology group is finite-dimensional for all n.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the real operator \(Q_{01310011}\) acting on the metric space. By the real decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|Q_{01310011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01310011\).

Step 2. The Lipschitz functional \(\Phi_{01310012}\) on the Lipschitz space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01310012}\| \leq C_01310012\) by the Lipschitz embedding theorem.

Step 3. The finite-rank functional \(\Phi_{01310013}\) on the schematic space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01310013}\| \leq C_01310013\) by the finite-rank embedding theorem.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via rational interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
